conventions.history_course_title: always the exact course code (required by current My Coach mapping)

conventions.quiz_scores: multiples of 5% (5 true/false questions weighted 1,2,4,8,5 = 20 marks)
conventions.prerequisites: kept in the My Coach catalog, never stored in RosarioSIS
